# netbox_contact_role (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/features/contacts/#contactroles):

> A contact role defines the relationship of a contact to an assigned object. For example, you might define roles for administrative, operational, and emergency contacts

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_contact_role" "test" {
  name = "test"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the contact role.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the contact role.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the contact role.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the contact role.
- `slug` (String) The URL-friendly slug of the contact role.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_contact_role.example 1
```
